summary: Setup and updates now give the database job its access by themselves, with no manual step.

fixes.title: Database job access is set up for you
fixes.text: Setup and every update add the database job to the database admin group through PIM, check it before the job starts, and renew it before it ends.

fixes.title: Clearer status after a new membership
fixes.text: Right after a new membership, a refused database sign-in shows as waiting, not as a failure.
